occurrences.text: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well’s mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.
Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
